title: CLEW: Log-Anchored Backward Tracing for Root-Cause Code Localization
abstract: arXiv:2611.19448v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Failures in industrial software systems may involve multiple components and be difficult to reproduce outside the production environment. Root-cause code localization therefore often relies on issue descriptions and runtime logs. However, log evidence may be noisy or incomplete, and the code reporting a symptom may differ from the code containing the underlying defect. These conditions make it challenging to identify relevant log evidence and determine which functions could have caused the reported failure. To address this gap, we introduce CLEW, an agentic approach that combines rule-based log-to-code anchoring with LLM-guided backward code tracing. CLEW organizes selected observations into diagnostic states, guides source exploration from anchored symptom functions, and returns ranked candidate functions, an affected module, and an explanation comprising a proposed mechanism path and associated log events. translated_title: CLEW：基于日志锚定的反向追踪根因代码定位方法
translated_abstract: 工业软件系统中的故障可能涉及多个组件，并且在生产环境之外难以复现。因此，根因代码定位通常依赖于问题描述和运行时日志。然而，日志证据可能存在噪声或不完整，且报告症状的代码可能不同于包含潜在缺陷的代码。这些条件使得识别相关日志证据以及确定哪些函数可能导致所报告的故障变得极具挑战性。为解决这一空白，我们提出了CLEW，一种结合基于规则的日志到代码锚定与大语言模型引导的反向代码追踪的智能体方法。CLEW将筛选出的观察结果组织为诊断状态，从锚定的症状函数出发引导源代码探索，并返回排序后的候选函数、受影响的模块，以及包含建议机制路径和相关日志事件的解释。在评估方面，我们构建了……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: CLEW是一种结合规则式日志到代码锚定与LLM引导反向代码追踪的智能体方法，可自动定位软件故障的根因函数并输出带机制路径与日志证据的可解释诊断结果。
